description: This is a CLI Python source file for a project initialization tool. It handles command-line arguments to create, configure, and retrieve information about various project templates and types, such as react, flutter, android, etc. It includes functions for parsing parameters, creating project configurations, and outputting JSON summaries of templates. The main script orchestrates command-line operations like project initialization and fetching run commands for specific project types.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Class representing template initialization information, including commands, environment config, and init files.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: Class encapsulating project configuration parameters such as name, version, description, author, type, output path, and additional parameters.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enumeration or class providing project type options and a method from_string to parse string representations.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Class responsible for creating project templates and initializing projects based on configurations.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] parse_parameters(params_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of key=value pairs into a dictionary with appropriately typed values.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_project_config(args)
methods.description: Creates a ProjectConfig object from CLI arguments.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_minimal_project_config(project_type: str, parameters: str = None)
methods.description: Creates a minimal ProjectConfig object to retrieve template info without full project details.

methods.name: str make_path_absolute(path: str, base_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a relative path to an absolute path based on a provided base path.

methods.name: dict template_init_info_to_dict(init_info: TemplateInitInfo, project_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a TemplateInitInfo instance into a dictionary suitable for JSON serialization, with absolute file paths.

methods.name: output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
methods.description: Outputs a formatted JSON object indicating success, message, and template configuration.

methods.name: output_get_run_command(project_type: str, run_command: str)
methods.description: Outputs the JSON containing the project type and its associated run command.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command(args)
methods.description: Handles the logic for extracting the run command for a given project type and parameters.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main entry point that parses arguments and coordinates project initialization or retrieval of run commands.

ctags.signature: (success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
